pages.description: The book threads are at the core of the spellbinder. They allow to give your binder special properties and effects, similar to how Armor Threads work. You can use an Alteration Table to slot up to two threads into the Spell Binder.

pages.title: Book Thread : Cheap Damage
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will greatly discount the spells cast from the equipped book but heavily reduce their damage.

pages.title: Book Thread : Slow Power
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will increase the damage of the spells cast from the equipped book but heavily reduce their speed.

pages.title: Book Thread : Sharp Pages
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will increase the melee damage if used as a weapon.

pages.title: Book Thread : Heavy Cover
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will increase the knockback of the spellbook if used as a melee weapon.

pages.title: Book Thread : Wheel of Fortune
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will randomly add positive augments to effects of your spells when equipped.
